个: go3 - measure word for general things (e.g. 两个字, 个电话)
该: goi1 - should; 唔该 = please / thanks / excuse me
阵: zan6 - a while (等阵 = wait a moment)

冇: mou5 - to not have (Cantonese char; = Mandarin 没有)
提: tai4 - to carry (手提 = mobile phone, short for 手提电话)

字: zi6 - character; 1 字 = 5 minutes on the clock (两个字 = 10 minutes)
